triage.kind_span: This Schedule TO relates to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares, designated Series B Auction Market Preferred Shares

subject_tickers.span: are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the NYSE) under the symbol GDV

security_class.span: Auction Market Preferred Shares, Series B, Par Value $0.001

price_basis.span: based upon a price of 96% of the liquidation preference of $25,000 per share (or $24,000 per share)

size_pct_outstanding.span: offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares

size_shares.span: aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer

commencement_date.span: from the commencement of the Exchange Offer on March 17, 2021

expiration_date.span: ON APRIL 14, 2021, UNLESS THE EXCHANGE OFFER IS EXTENDED

spans: The Exchange Offer is conditioned on, among other things, holders of an aggregate of at least a majority of the outstanding Auction Rate Preferred Shares properly tendering (and not validly withdrawing) their Auction Rate Preferred Shares at or prior to the Expiration Date.

trigger_origin.span: The Fund believes that the Exchange Offer will enable the Fund to reduce its dividend obligations

notes: Issuer exchange offer for unlisted auction-rate preferred shares (Series B, C, E) into newly issued Series J term preferred shares (0.96 Series J share per ARPS share, cash in lieu of fractions); not a cash tender at a percent of NAV, so price_basis is other and price_pct_nav is null. size_pct_outstanding is the stated 'up to 100%'; size_shares 6,371 is the share count stated in the fee table footnote. GDV is the ticker of the common shares as printed; the preferred shares subject to the offer are not listed. Bank of America holds 94.0% of the ARPS and has agreed to tender; the offer is conditioned on a majority tendering. Withdrawal right after 40 business days. Proration not stated in the excerpt. The excerpt is cut mid-section (inside The Exchange Offer, Purpose and Effects), so the detailed Conditions section is not in view. No results fields.
